verdict.rationale: Asana documents dedicated AI features—AI Studio, 'Asana Dash: Your AI Chief of Staff', and AI Teammates with shared memory drawing on the Work Graph—plus MCP tools that explicitly 'generate reports and summaries based on Asana data', all pointing to in-product AI-generated insights and suggestions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and concrete examples of the suggestions/insights generated, since all evidence is vendor-authored.
